messages:
Janelle: Hi team - quick Q about the childcare backup benefit. My kids preschool has two planned closure days next month and Ill need care. Can I use the backup stipend for an in-home sitter I already know (my sister), and what paperwork do you need? Also any limits for recurring use during scheduled closures?
Maya: Hey Janelle  welcome back planning! Short answers: yes you can use the backup stipend for a family member in many cases but we need an accredited caregiver form + background attestation. The stipend covers emergency/backup care and short-term scheduled closures (up to 5 days per quarter) but not regular ongoing daycare.
Janelle: Good to know. Whats the accredited caregiver form look like? Do we need a background check run through Redwood?
HR-Compliance: We require either (A) a signed Caregiver Attestation form (caregiver signs confirming no disqualifying convictions and allergy/training info) plus a photo ID, or (B) if the caregiver is non-household or you prefer, you can request a vendor background check through our partner (cost covered by employee, can be reimbursed under certain conditions). We do not run mandatory checks for family household members unless the role is overnight or involves vulnerable persons.
Ben: Manager note: as long as you post the coverage blocks on calendar and update on-call, we're fine with scheduled closures. If its during a critical launch window well ask for a brief swap plan but otherwise its approved.
Janelle: Great — process steps? Ill need to submit receipts and the attestation before next Friday.
Maya: Steps: 1) Have caregiver sign the Caregiver Attestation (link below) and upload to HR portal -> Benefits > Caregiver Forms. 2) Book care and keep invoice/receipt. 3) Submit expense with code CHILDCARE-BACKUP and attach receipt + attestation. 4) People Ops approves within 7-10 business days. Note: if caregiver is unpaid family member, attach a short note explaining arrangement and dates.
Janelle: Is there a per-event cap and an annual cap?
Maya: Backup stipend: $500/quarter per employee, per-event reimbursement cap of $200 unless pre-approved. If you need more for multiple closure days, request an exception with a short justification and well review.
Janelle: My kid has a severe nut allergy. Do you require the caregiver to have epi-pen training or certification?
HR-Compliance: We strongly recommend documented allergy training for the caregiver. For reimbursement we ask that the attestation include allergy management steps and that you upload proof of the caregivers willingness to administer emergency medication. If the caregiver is unwilling, well ask you to use an accredited backup care vendor instead.
Janelle: If my sister signs and we upload the attestation today, how fast can expense go through?
people-ops-bot: Ticket HR-BACKUP-331 created for Janelle. People Ops aims to approve typical backup stipend claims within 7 business days of complete submission.
Maya: Also FYI: recurring scheduled closures (like every school PD day) are allowed but count toward the quarterly cap. If you anticipate regular use, tell us and we can discuss an adjusted childcare allowance through Total Rewards.
Janelle: Thanks all, Ill upload the attestation and receipt later today. Appreciate the quick help!
